query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T18:35:57Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:35:57Z"
        AND destination.port == 22
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        earliest = MIN(@timestamp),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, destination.ip
| SORT total DESC
| LIMIT 20
